Name: Daily Luck and Weather Predictions
Author: 91BlaDe
Description:
There are a number of RNG results that are based on the number of steps that have been taken.

This Mod displays on screen the number of steps that have been taken, as well as the results of this RNG if the player was to sleep with the current step count.

This mod displays:
Daily Luck for tomorrow
Dish of the Day and number available for tomorrow
The name of the NPC who is sending a gift in the mail tomorrow

Each of these items can be turned on and off in the config file, as well as the position for the display.
Any changes can be refreshed with F5.

You can input target criteria in the config file.

TargetLuck:  The desired minimum luck.  -1 to skip, otherwise a number between -0.1 and +0.1.
TargetGifter: The desired gift giver. Empty to skip, otherwise a comma delimited list of NPC names.
TargetDish: The desired dish of the day.  Empty to skip, otherwise a comma delimited list of dishes.
TargetDishAmount: The desired minimum number of dishes in dish of the day.  Tied into TargetDish.
TargetStepsLimit: The amount of additional steps checked for hitting the target criteria.
